## What does this PR change?

<!-- Add / update / remove / fix — one line is enough. -->

- [ ] Add a tool
- [ ] Update an entry (new flagship version, pricing, description)
- [ ] Remove a tool
- [ ] Fix a link or typo
- [ ] Docs / repo maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Both `README.md` **and** `README-CN.md` are updated — a change in only one language is a bug.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/format_readmes.py` (required after any table edit).
- [ ] Links resolve; the `link-check` CI workflow is green.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated **only** for additions, removals, renames, or a refresh to a new flagship version. Typo fixes, link repairs, and reordering do not need an entry.
- [ ] Deep-dive content for a new tool is published as a Discussion (EN + CN), **not** a new page under `docs/`.
- [ ] Fees field uses one of `Free` / `Paid` / `Free/Paid` / `Free Trial`.
- [ ] Markers used sparingly: `🌟` only for a clear first choice, `🌱` only for early-stage products.
